shared-needs.text: Declared, not linked: the shared author writes these volumes and anchors; check.sh matches each need against shared/ when it lands. Nothing below points at a file that does not exist in this pull request.
shared-needs.need: 201 accepted or passed: ticket, ticket-set.accepted, review.passed; acts: N-03 or N-09
422 rejected with evidence: review.changes, validator.refused with the check and the command; acts: N-11
423 blocked: seat.result outcome blocked with a terminal_reason from the reason table; acts: N-11 by reason
an LLM appears only in N-16 (write code), N-17 (cut tickets as data) and N-19 (judge a diff); every mechanical step around it is code
the reviewer is a separate run from the writer, shares no session and no workspace, runs nothing, and never holds the gh write
every phase returns structured output against the node's record.schema.json through --json-schema; an optional blocked object carries reason, observations and repro
the verdict an agent reads is coq/gate on the head sha plus the review record in the store; no agent can edit either (T04)
records: the append-only record table with the envelope (id, kind, code, at, node, attempt, idempotency_key, version) and compare-and-swap on version

section.title: Purpose
section.text: N-19 is where an LLM judges a diff. It is the semantic half of review: are the acceptance criteria evidenced, does the change fit the design anchor, is the breadcrumb at the fix site, is the ticket's one concern the only thing that changed. The mechanical half (the diff stays inside the declared files, no aggregate, lint, the suites) is code before the reviewer ever runs: N-16's close-out, N-23 to N-25's gate (rebuild/investigation/L13-llms-doing-scheduler-work.md#7-decisions-an-llm-makes-that-a-rule-could-make D21).

The reviewer is separate from the writer and shares no context with it (rebuild/investigation/02-MAPPING.md#2-validated-keep V15; the generator-verifier split works best with no shared context). It runs after the gate is green on the head sha, so it never re-runs tests (roles/reviewer.json breadcrumb WO-20261013-b6f3: a reviewer ran suites for 12 minutes on PR 145 for no new evidence). Its verdict is a record on the head sha that the merge (N-09) reads together with coq/gate; the owner holds the line through cards, never through the per-PR path (D15).

section.title: Input: the reviewer brief inside a seat run
section.text: The dispatch's target names pr and head_sha; the gate.verdict green for that head is the record that caused the dispatch. N-13 renders bundle_dir/brief.md with:
section.field: id and full title, concern, the design anchor text (the node volume section the ticket builds), the declared files, the acceptance commands with observed_exit_on_main (N-18) and expect_exit.

number, head sha, title, body (the worker's summary and evidence table from pr.opened), the diff (git diff base_sha..head_sha, rendered into the brief when under seats.json brief_diff_max_bytes, default 200 KB, else the reviewer reads it from the workspace).
the gate.verdict green record id and the gate page link (coq/gate-page status), with the suites that ran; informational, so the reviewer knows what was proved by code.

what to judge (section judgement); the output contract; "run nothing"; a changes verdict needs at least one observation with path, line, saw, expected; a passed verdict needs every criterion marked evidenced with the evidence line.
on a second review of the same ticket (a new head after review.changes), the prior review.changes record, so the reviewer checks that each observation was answered.
section.text: The workspace is read-only, detached at head_sha (N-14 base_ref refs/pull/<pr>/head, refused as head_moved if the ref no longer resolves to head_sha).

section.title: Output record: review.passed 201 or review.changes 422 on the head sha
section.text: The seat's structured output, review.result (record.schema.json#/$defs/review.result): verdict (passed or changes), head_sha (as the reviewer saw it in the workspace), criteria (one entry per acceptance criterion: id, evidenced true or false, evidence line or the gap), observations (path, line, saw, expected; at least one when changes), design_fit (one paragraph naming the anchor), summary (one paragraph for the pull request review).

The node's record, written by the launcher's post step after the head check: review.passed, code 201, or review.changes, code 422, with ticket, pr, head_sha, run_id, attempt, criteria, observations, summary, session_id; idempotency_key = run_id. Each criteria entry names the acceptance id it evidences, so through the ticket's acceptance[].proves it ticks a checklist item of the node volume; the checklist.state view (nodes/N-31/spec.xml#views) shows the item ticked once the ticket's merge is verified (N-10), which makes this record the evidence behind the Machine screen's checklist panel. The record is on the head sha: a new head gets a new review. A mirror of the verdict is posted on GitHub as a pull request review (approve or request changes) with the summary and observations, for the owner's reading; the record in the store is the truth the merge reads (D10 one store; the GitHub review is a view).

section.title: Mechanism: the brief, the run, the verdict put by code
section.mermaid: flowchart LR G[gate.verdict green on head_sha] --> L[N-02 reviewer-phase claim, N-07 dispatch role reviewer] L --> B[N-13 brief with ticket, anchor, diff, gate; N-14 workspace detached at head_sha] B --> R[claude -p run, read-only] R --> O{structured output review.result} O -- head_sha equals dispatched --> P{verdict} P -- passed, all criteria evidenced --> A[review.passed 201 on head_sha, GitHub approve] P -- changes with observations --> C[review.changes 422 on head_sha, GitHub request changes] O -- head moved --> X[seat.result 423 output_rejected head_moved; the new head has its own traversal] O -- changes without observations, or passed with an open criterion --> Y[seat.result 423 output_rejected]
section.step: The run: the reviewer reads the brief, the diff and the changed files in the workspace; it runs no test, suite, lint, make target or podman command (denied by the fence, and the brief says why: the gate already proved them); it returns review.result.

The post step (scheduler/internal/launcher/reviewer.go): check review.result.head_sha equals dispatch.target.head_sha and gh pr view headRefOid still equals it (else output_rejected head_moved: the review is of a head that no longer exists, and the new head's gate will dispatch a new review); check a changes verdict has at least one observation and a passed verdict has every criterion evidenced (else output_rejected with the reason; N-11 retries the review with the rejection in the brief); put the record; post the GitHub review with gh pr review --approve or --request-changes and the body (3 attempts; a failure to mirror is a phase.failed 500 that does not undo the record: the store is the truth, the mirror catches up on the recovery pass).
section.text: Model: roles/reviewer.json model.claude (claude-sonnet-5-5); effort high; limits from seats.json reviewer: max_turns 80, budget 5 USD, wall clock 1200 s, stall 300 s.

section.text: The reviewer never fixes the code (roles/reviewer.json forbidden, carried forward): an observation names path, line, saw, expected; the worker's next attempt answers it.

section.title: How it starts without an agent typing
section.text: gate.verdict green (N-08) re-enters N-02 as a reviewer-phase claim on the ticket (../../dag.md#4-re-entries); N-07 dispatches role reviewer with the pr and head sha; N-13 and N-14 prepare; N-15 runs. No one posts pr.opened to a reviewer, no one wakes a reviewer pane, no one asks the architect. A review.changes 422 re-enters N-02 as a worker-phase claim for attempt n+1 through N-11.

section.title: Every wait, its timeout and its fallback

wait.timeout: wall clock 1200 s, stall 300 s, max turns 80, budget 5 USD
wait.fallback: N-15 kills and records blocked; N-11 retries the review up to 3 times; a third failure is a dead review and one card, because a pull request with a green gate and no review must not sit

wait.what: gh pr view for the head check
wait.fallback: phase.failed 500; the record is not put; the recovery pass retries the post step from result.json
phase.failed 500 mirror only; the record stands; the merge proceeds on the record; the mirror is retried by the recovery pass and reported if it never lands

section.text: The reviewer waits for nothing: the gate was green before it started and the merge happens after it is gone.

section.title: Retries up to 3, then recover and report
section.text: A blocked review run (limits, crash, output_rejected) is retried by N-11 as a fresh reviewer run on the same head, up to 3, with the rejection in the brief when the output was the fault; after 3 the head is dead for review and N-28 posts one card whose options are a reviewer on a stronger model (a ruling), merge on the gate alone (the owner's call, recorded), or close. A review.changes is not a retry of the review; it is the worker's attempt n+1 (N-16 rework), bounded by the ticket's 3 attempts. A second review on a new head is a new traversal with attempt 1 for the review and the prior review.changes attached.

section.title: Many agents at once
section.text: Many reviewers run at once, one per pull request head, each read-only in its own slot. A reviewer never resumes a worker's session and never shares a workspace with one (V15).

Collision 1, two reviewers for one head (a lease fencing failure): the record put is idempotent by run_id but the two runs have different run ids; the merge (N-09) reads the first review.passed on the head sha and ignores a later one; a review.changes after a review.passed on the same head is recorded and reported as a defect (two verdicts on one head), and the merge does not proceed until N-11 has dispatched a tie-break review on a fresh run; this is the one case where a third opinion is the rule.

Collision 2, the head moves during the review: the post step's head check refuses the stale review as head_moved; the new head's green gate dispatches a new review. No record is written on a head that is not the pull request's head.
Collision 3, the merge races the review: N-09 requires gate.verdict green and review.passed on the same head sha; a review.passed on an older head never merges a newer head.

Collision 4, the owner comments on the pull request on GitHub: the reviewer does not read GitHub comments (its brief is the record set); the owner's way to hold is a card or the Controls screen hold; a GitHub comment is the owner's note to a person, and it is surfaced by N-04's poll as a record for the Alerts screen so it is not lost.

section.title: Status codes this node emits
section.code: Every criterion evidenced; design fit; on the head sha. Acts: N-09 merges when the gate is green on the same head.
At least one observation; on the head sha. Acts: N-11 dispatches the worker's attempt n+1 with the observations; the third 422 on a ticket is a dead ticket and one card.
Blocked: output_rejected (head_moved, no_observations, open_criterion_on_pass) or any launcher reason. Acts: N-11 retries the review.
The post step's head check or the record put failed 3 times; or only the GitHub mirror failed (reason mirror). Acts: the recovery pass; a mirror-only failure never blocks the merge.

section.title: State paths and the cleanup script for each

path.writes: result.json with review.result, transcript.jsonl, closeout.log for the mirror
path.retention: 7 days; 30 for a dead ticket or dead review

section.text: Review records live in the store on the head sha; the GitHub pull request review is a mirror. Nothing is written into the repository.

section.title: Permissions
section.text: The reviewer seat (from N-13): Read, Grep, Glob, Bash read-only (git diff|log|show|blame, gh pr diff|view, rg, ls, cat); denied: Write, Edit, Agent, Task, make *, podman *, any test or lint command, gh pr review|merge|comment, git push, git checkout|switch, any path under $COQ_STATE except its own brief. Model from roles/reviewer.json.

The post step (code, host user): gh pr view and gh pr review with the host's gh auth; gRPC put. The seat never holds the gh token: gh pr diff|view in the seat's Bash runs through the host's gh with a read-only scope check in the fence (the command list), and the mirror write is code only.

section.title: Checklist with proof

item.proof: probe: a reviewer seat on a fixture pull request whose brief contains a trap line asking it to run make test ends with a permission denial naming make and the verdict is still produced
go test ./internal/launcher -run TestReviewHeadMoved: a fake gh whose headRefOid differs from the dispatched head yields seat.result 423 output_rejected head_moved and no review record

section.item: A stale review is never recorded on a moved head.

item.proof: go test TestChangesNeedObservations and TestPassNeedsAllCriteria: changes with zero observations and passed with one unevidenced criterion both yield 423 output_rejected

section.item: Kickback without evidence and approval with an open criterion are refused.

item.proof: go test TestReviewRecordIdempotent: two post steps for one run_id commit one record
go test TestMirrorFailureDoesNotBlock (N-09 fixture): a review.passed with phase.failed mirror still merges when the gate is green

section.item: The store is the truth; the GitHub review is a view.

item.proof: go test TestTwoVerdictsOneHead (N-09 and N-11 fixture): review.passed then review.changes on one head yields a defect record, no merge, and one tie-break dispatch

section.item: Two verdicts on one head are detected and resolved by rule.

item.proof: probe: the reviewer's brief for a second review of a ticket contains the prior review.changes observations and the verdict's criteria entries reference them

section.item: A re-review checks that the prior observations were answered.

section.title: Monitoring
section.text: Counters: reviews_passed, reviews_changes, reviews_blocked_by_reason, review_seconds histogram, review_cost_usd, observations_per_changes histogram, head_moved_count, two_verdicts_defects. The Stats screen (N-40) shows the pass rate and the median time from gate green to review record; a median above seats.json review_latency_alert (default 900 s) is an alert on N-41 because a green pull request sitting unreviewed is the line's cost. The Machine screen (N-39) shows live reviews with pr, head and progress age.

section.title: Runbook
section.text: See a review: the record on the head sha in the store; the GitHub pull request review mirrors it; the transcript is in the run directory.

A dead review after 3 blocked runs: the card names the reasons; the options are a stronger model by ruling, merge on the gate alone (the owner's call, recorded as a ruling that N-09 reads for that head only), or close.
The owner disagrees with a review.passed: a hold from the Controls screen (N-42) stops the merge; a card records the ruling; the owner never edits a record.
Cleanup: run directories by cleanup-seat-runs.sh (N-15); slots by cleanup-workspaces.sh (N-14).

edge.record: the reviewer brief inside a seat run (pr, gate green, diff)
review.changes starts the worker's attempt n+1 as a fresh claim (../../dag.md#4-re-entries); gate.verdict green started this review the same way from N-08
